Hi there, it’s Nancy Lacore, the Democrat running to flip South Carolina’s First District.
I have a lot of thoughts about what’s been going on with Pete Hegseth.
Not only did he remove me from my position as Chief of the Navy Reserve after 35 years of service, but he’s actively undermining the foundation of our military.
Hegseth has fired more than a dozen senior military officers, including an Army chief of staff and two other generals who were ousted recently.

body:
Meet the speakers of Freedom Fest, only 12 days away!
| | | | [](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
---
**June 14, 2026** **SUNDAY NEWS DIGEST**
| | Dear Rocky Mountain Voice family,
Happy Flag Day! 🇺🇸
On June 14, 1777, the Continental Congress adopted the Stars and Stripes as the official flag of the United States. Nearly 250 years later, that flag still flies over a nation that is far from perfect—but remains the greatest experiment in self-government the world has ever known.
And that's exactly why Freedom Fest matters.
In just **12 days** , Coloradans from across the state will gather to celebrate America's 250th Birthday and Colorado's 150th Birthday—not simply to talk about freedom, but to celebrate it.
And this week, we want to introduce a few of the voices joining us.
🎤 **[Seth Keshel](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** is a former Army intelligence captain and election analyst whose work has earned the attention of leaders like Newt Gingrich. Whether you agree with his conclusions or not, Keshel has become one of the most influential voices in the election integrity movement and will be speaking Friday at Freedom Fest.
🎤 **[Pastor Lorenzo Sewell](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** brings one of the most powerful redemption stories we've ever featured. From drug dealer to pastor, his journey from Detroit's streets to delivering the benediction at President Trump's inauguration is a testament to faith, second chances, and the power of transformation. He'll speak on the main stage and at the Mountain Majesty Gala.
🎤 **[Mark Cook](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** has spent years studying election systems and advocating for greater transparency and local oversight. A former technology professional, Cook argues that restoring trust in elections starts with putting more power back in the hands of voters and county clerks.
🎤 **[Larry Gatlin](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** may be best known for his legendary music career, but our recent interview revealed something deeper: a grandfather, storyteller, man of faith, and defender of the values he believes are worth passing on to the next generation.
🎤 **[Erin Lee](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** will also take the stage after becoming one of Colorado's most prominent parental rights advocates. Her story—and the broader debate over student speech and parental involvement in schools—has resonated with families across the state.
**🎤[Patti Fox](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** will share the heartbreaking story of her daughter Carissa, whose life was forever changed after a devastating crash. Her story has become a powerful reminder of perseverance, faith, and the human cost behind public policy debates.
🎤 **[Jacki& Noelle Caskey](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** became national voices for student speech after 13-year-old Noelle was barred from reading her pro-life poem in class because it was deemed "too politically charged." What started as a school assignment reached millions online, and the mother-daughter duo will share their story of standing up for free expression, parental rights, and the courage to speak your beliefs.
_**🎟️ A Few Important Freedom Fest Updates**_
**Kids Attend Free:** We've made it even easier for families to join us. _Children 17 and under now receive**free Bronze Pass** admission with a ticketed adult. That includes access to the rodeo, Family Fun Festival, Curtis Grimes concert, candidate meet-and-greet, food vendors, and more._
**Pricing Changes:** We made pricing more accessible and easy to understand! 🥉 _**Bronze Pass $45**_ \- _rodeo, Family Fun Festival, Curtis Grimes concert, candidate meet-and-greet, food vendors, and more._ 🥈 _**Silver Pass $95** \- everything in Bronze + all speakers Friday & Saturday (includes Gutfeld!) + Back the Blue Bash._ 🥇 _**Gold Pass $195** \- everything in Silver + Mountain Majesty Gala + drone show!_ 💎 _**Platinum VIP $495** \- everything in Gold + VIP seating, parking & PHOTO with Nick Shirley!_
**Volunteers Needed:** Want to be part of the team helping make Freedom Fest happen? We're actively recruiting volunteers and would love your help. Whether it's guest services, logistics, setup, or hospitality, there are opportunities for everyone. _**[Click here to sign up!](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**_
👉 **[Get your tickets now!](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
In truth & liberty,
Team RMV
---
[FREEDOM FEST TICKETS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
| | |
---
| | **TOP STORIES OF THE WEEK**
---
**[Colorado grew on a wave. The wave is gone.](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY SHAINA COLE, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) Colorado crossed six million people in 2025, according to the U.S. Census Bureau. Headlines called it a milestone. What they didn’t report is how the state got there, and what’s left now that the wave behind the growth has receded.

**[Colorado calls its elections a model. Mark Cook says voters have lost oversight of them](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY RMV STAFF, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) Colorado’s top election officials call the state’s voting system a national model. Secretary of State Jena Griswold has described it as the “gold standard,” pointing to first-in-the-nation risk-limiting audits, bipartisan checks and ballot tracking.

**[Eleven Colorado lawmakers on the ballot first reached office through appointment](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY JEN SCHUMANN, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) Every Coloradan who feels ignored at the Capitol can take comfort in this: they have not one but two people assigned to listen. Your House member splits attention among roughly 92,500 residents. Your senator, among about 171,800.

|
---
**STATE**
**[From coal transition to data centers: JOLT summit heads to Grand Junction](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY JEN SCHUMANN, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) Before JOLT became an annual summit, local leaders across Northwest Colorado were wrestling with a difficult question: What comes after coal? Now they’re holding their fourth summit, and this year’s program includes discussions on geothermal energy, data centers, critical minerals, electric cooperative power supplies, workforce development and Colorado River issues.
**[From dope dealer to hope dealer: Detroit pastor Lorenzo Sewell brings message of redemption to Colorado](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY SHAINA COLE, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) He walked into church on April 18, 1999, with a bruised brow, money in his pocket, and murder on his mind. By the time he walked out, Lorenzo Sewell had given his life to Christ. That same day he went to his drug boss and quit. That day, and that decision, is the foundation of everything Sewell has built since.
**[Property taxes up, TABOR refunds nearly gone: El Paso County data reveals the real cost of Colorado’s tax system](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY SHAINA COLE, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) The first-half property tax payment is due every year by the end of February. The number on the front has gone up again. Somewhere near the bottom, a small credit appears: “TABOR credit.”
_**[READ MORE STATE NEWS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**_
|
---
**LOCAL**
**[Colorado Mountain Town Revolts After AI Cameras and Robots Spark Privacy Concerns](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**[THE COLORADO SUN](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) First, it was the robots. They were trundling along sidewalks in Paonia last summer gathering data on how accommodating those thoroughfares were for people with disabilities. The wandering robots took townspeople by complete surprise.
**[Denver Public Schools Grows Bureaucracy While Student Population Declines](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**[DENVER GAZETTE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) Denver Public Schools (DPS) has operated with thousands fewer students than its peak enrollment in 2019 but it has grown its administrative ranks back to nearly their pre-pandemic level, a Denver Gazette analysis of state staffing data shows.
__
**[Cherry Creek Schools Target Of New Federal Civil Rights Investigation](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [DENVER GAZETTE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) The U.S. Department of Education opened an investigation into Cherry Creek School District on Monday over allegations of racial discrimination. The department said its Office for Civil Rights is reviewing claims that the district violated Title VI of the Civil Rights Act by sponsoring “a wide range of racially-discriminatory programming.”
**_[READ MORE LOCAL NEWS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)_**
|
---
**COMMENTARY**
**[Five candidates agreed Colorado has problems. Voters must decide who owns them](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY RMV EDITORIAL BOARD, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) _Colorado has become so expensive that starter homes are starting to sound less like milestones and more like bucket-list items. Businesses are beginning to treat Colorado the way some retirees treat winter: nice place to visit, not entirely sure about staying. The surprising part isn’t that Republicans said so. It’s that Democrats did too._ __
**[The reliability weapon: Humpty’s wall](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY DRAKE HUNTER, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) _Most people think the lesson of Humpty Dumpty is about falling. It isn’t. It’s about trust. You don’t sit on a wall unless you trust the wall. You don’t climb high unless you trust what holds you up. And you don’t build relationships unless you trust the people around you. The real tragedy wasn’t that Humpty fell. Everyone falls._
**[If Polis vetoed it, maybe Colorado should take a closer look](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**[COLORADO ACCOUNTABILITY PROJECT](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) _I guess we can’t say Polis never vetoes, it’s just rare. I wanted to share a couple of articles (one by Complete Colorado linked first below and the second by CPR) detailing some vetoes from Governor Polis this legislative session. I’ll leave it to you to poke around in either or both articles, but there are a couple of notable things I wanted to mention._
**_[READ MORE COMMENTARY](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)_**
|
---
**NATIONAL**
**[Rand Paul Releases Records Alleging Years of NIH Biosafety Failures](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**[JUST THE NEWS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) New documents released by Senate Committee on Homeland Security and Governmental Affairs Chairman Rand Paul, R-Ky., reveal that two National Institutes of Health scientists were charged with conspiring to smuggle monkeypox virus samples into the United States after returning from the Congo.

**[Senate Approves $70 Billion Immigration Enforcement Funding Package](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**[NPR NEWS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) The U.S. Senate passed an approximately $70 billion funding bill for federal immigration enforcement, without any reforms, early Friday morning, 52-47. Colorado Sen. John Hickenlooper voted against the measure, while Sen. Michael Bennet missed the final passage vote and the preceding 18-hour marathon of back-to-back amendment votes known as a “vote-a-rama.” __
**[Christians cannot retreat from the public square](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [UNDERCURRENT SUBSTACK](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) _Many American Christians have mistaken political exhaustion for spiritual wisdom. They look at the public square and see corruption, division, ambition, deceit, and the machinery of worldly power. Then, with a kind of pious resignation, they conclude that politics is simply too dirty for the faithful._
_**[READ MORE NATIONAL NEWS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**_
|

We vote for candidates. We also vote for principles. No issue is more of a core principle on your ballot than our fundamental right to vote. With Trump's MAGA movement working to suppress the vote and using government agencies to raid voter registration groups, the importance of this election is clear.
Please, Team, RUSH $35 or more right now to fuel our work to register, inform, and turn out every voter possible for the midterms >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=061426_3&amount=35]
Voter Action Project [https://voteractionproject.org/]
Our democracy is on your ballot this year, Team , seriously.
This isn’t just a figure of speech or hyperbole. More than a third of state ballot measures that voters like you will face this year relate to our democracy. On top of that, voters nationwide are electing the officials who will run the 2028 elections with their votes in the midterms.
That’s why our work to inform, register, and turn out voters is more important than ever. Pitch in $35 or whatever you can to help fuel our work for voting rights today >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=061426_3&amount=35]

By Election Day, voters will make decisions on voting rights, election processes, redistricting, and many other key electoral issues, let alone control of Congress, state legislatures, governorships, and more.
We have our chance to directly fight back against the voter suppression and voter discrimination we're seeing play out in real time from the anti-voting elected officials in power right now.
But opponents of voting rights are still hard at work to disenfranchise voters who have a say in these decisions, because they know that our vote is our power . That's why we’re so focused on voter registration, education, and empowerment. Our fundamental right to vote is at stake, and we cannot afford to lose.

Integrity First Voter Action Project is dedicated to expanding ballot access and increasing voter participation across the country.
Since the Supreme Court gutted key provisions in the Voting Rights Act, extreme politicians have taken advantage to pass harsh laws that restrict access to the ballot box. These restrictions particularly affect disadvantaged communities and people of color. It’s our goal to bring awareness to these laws wherever they may crop up and organize voters to take action to ensure the right to vote is available to everyone in their states and communities.

body:

Derek, The latest public poll of the general election in Ohio was just released, and you need to take a look: [](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dnc-brown-split?refcode=em_20260614_7550_fr&amount=20&refcode2=7550_22930333_mE4nEG&akid=7550%2E22930333%2EmE4nEG) This is a big deal. The data proves Ohio is ready to unseat my opponent, Jon Husted, and pave a path for us to flip the Senate in November. **The momentum behind our campaign is growing, but so is the target on our backs. Republicans can see we’re putting up a fight, and they’re going to do whatever it takes to try and stop us in our tracks.** [**Before I say more, can you split any amount between my campaign and the DNC so we can hit our $100K rapid response goal and take on whatever’s next?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dnc-brown-split?amount=20&refcode=em_20260614_7550_fr&refcode2=7550_22930333_mE4nEG&akid=7550%2E22930333%2EmE4nEG) **[SPLIT $20](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dnc-brown-split?amount=20&refcode=em_20260614_7550_fr&refcode2=7550_22930333_mE4nEG&akid=7550%2E22930333%2EmE4nEG)** What we’re building together is truly remarkable, and I see it at every stop I make across the state. body:
https://hanksforcolorado.com?utm_source=Hanks+for+Colorado&utm_campaign=2501ac22e9-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2026_06_15_02_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-2501ac22e9-586962644

Conservative Republican · US House – District 3 · June 30 Primary

🏴 Happy Flag Day — 16 Days Until June 30 — Your Ballot Is In Your Hands 🏴
▶ Watch Ron's Flag Day Message → (https://youtube.com/shorts/UXVPNJpukeA?feature=share&utm_source=Hanks+for+Colorado&utm_campaign=2501ac22e9-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2026_06_15_02_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-2501ac22e9-586962644)

An Appeal to Patriots and Veteran Voters on Flag Day

It has been an emotional stretch of patriotic holidays — Memorial Day, D-Day, Flag Day, with Independence Day approaching in our nation's 250th year. I'm grateful President Trump is leading, but I see real threats on the horizon and at home.

I served 32 years in the Air Force — active, reserve, civilian, enlisted, and commissioned. More than half my life in uniform. I'm fully vested in this country, yet uneasy about where we stand. Our government has grown too powerful, operated covertly against its own citizens, wasted our treasure, and laundered it for their political benefit. It belonged to our families and children.

This government no longer represents us. Career politicians treat their districts as inconveniences while lobbyists and DC insiders pull the strings. They mail deceptive LIAR FLYERS by the ton, dodge town halls and interviews, and protect the status quo.

I'm running for Congress for one final tour of duty: Advance the America First agenda, help elect the next conservative President, then come home after four years — citizen-soldier, citizen-legislator, citizen again. That's the model our Founders established and challenged us to keep.

I've done the interviews with local papers, radio, and TV. My opponent has declined them. I've answered dozens of detailed questionnaires with clear positions. He offers generics. I've sought zero endorsements — just your consideration and your vote.
------------------------------------------------------------
Ron Showed Up. Hurd Didn't.

** Two major CD3 newspapers asked both candidates the hard questions this week.
------------------------------------------------------------

Ron answered every one. Jeff Hurd declined to be interviewed.

Grand Junction Sentinel

** Q&A: Ron Hanks — Challenging Rep. Jeff Hurd from the Right in CD3
------------------------------------------------------------

Ron answered every hard question on tariffs, federal lands, the border, and constituent access. Jeff Hurd? No comment.
READ THE FULL Q&A → (https://www.gjsentinel.com/news/western_colorado/q-a-ron-hanks-challenging-rep-jeff-hurd-from-the-right-in-cd3/article_635eb49f-2fdd-46c2-bb58-6f0596f64c0a.html?utm_source=Hanks+for+Colorado&utm_campaign=2501ac22e9-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2026_06_15_02_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-2501ac22e9-586962644)

Aspen Times

** A Republican Congressman Is Trying to Hold Onto His Western Colorado Seat. His Primary Challenger Says the District Needs a Stronger Conservative.
------------------------------------------------------------

The Aspen Times covered the CD3 primary — and noted Hurd declined to participate.
READ THE FULL ARTICLE → (https://www.aspentimes.com/news/colorado-rep-jeff-hurd-congressman-conservative/?utm_source=Hanks+for+Colorado&utm_campaign=2501ac22e9-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2026_06_15_02_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-2501ac22e9-586962644)
▶ WATCH: Ron Hanks on Free State Colorado — Full Interview (https://youtu.be/9K4CO4hqsVw?si=Xc48h5P_V2cAIiyO&utm_source=Hanks+for+Colorado&utm_campaign=2501ac22e9-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2026_06_15_02_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-2501ac22e9-586962644)
------------------------------------------------------------

** 🌟 Ron On the Issues — Real Questions. Straight Answers.
------------------------------------------------------------

Every video in this series is a real question — answered directly. No handlers. No script. No dodge. 32 years of service means you've earned the straight answer every time.
WATCH RON ON THE ISSUES → (https://hanksforcolorado.com/q-a?utm_source=Hanks+for+Colorado&utm_campaign=2501ac22e9-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2026_06_15_02_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-2501ac22e9-586962644)
------------------------------------------------------------

Visit HanksForColorado.com (https://hanksforcolorado.com?utm_source=Hanks+for+Colorado&utm_campaign=2501ac22e9-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2026_06_15_02_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-2501ac22e9-586962644) to learn more.

If you want a true conservative who will support President Trump, vote for me — Top Line on the ballot. My opponent is rated "F" by Heritage Action (https://heritageaction.com/scorecard/members/H001100?utm_source=Hanks+for+Colorado&utm_campaign=2501ac22e9-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2026_06_15_02_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-2501ac22e9-586962644) , a full 26 points below average.

We have the greatest system of government in the world, but corruption and waste have overwhelmed it. Fake conservatives won't fix it. I will.
Respectfully,

Ron Hanks
Candidate, US House of Representatives, District 3

Jun 15
---

| | | [](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=7534176&post_id=202064904&utm_source=substack&isFreemail=true&submitLike=true&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MjAyMDY0OTA0LCJyZWFjdGlvbiI6IuKdpCIsImlhdCI6MTc4MTQ4OTg4MSwiZXhwIjoxNzg0MDgxODgxLCJpc3MiOiJwdWItNzUzNDE3NiIsInN1YiI6InJlYWN0aW9uIn0.EkIg5XBQ9tkLchbVk5gRIhP1GLUde4Oa9Lxh_wE38RM&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=email-reaction&r=1hvr60)

The political class in Nashville has a timeline. They've calculated exactly how much money their corporate PACs will pump into this race, exactly how many lines they need to redraw to secure their "safe seats," and exactly when they expect our grassroots movement to run out of gas.
Right now, they are looking at our end-of-week deadline, waiting to see if we stumble.
**[We are trailing our fundraising goal by $500, and the clock is officially running out.](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/adb0ea28-af62-40f6-9ef4-a544c572132f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**

---|---|---
They want to claim that the community has accepted that "normal" is dead. _**Help prove them wrong with a small-dollar donation[HERE.](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/adb0ea28-af62-40f6-9ef4-a544c572132f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**_
[PITCH IN TO OUR GOAL HERE!](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/adb0ea28-af62-40f6-9ef4-a544c572132f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
### **What 's On the Line Right Now**
This isn't about hitting an arbitrary number to look good on a spreadsheet. This goal dictates exactly how hard we can swing back against the corporate machine. Falling short means making compromises we can't afford:
They want us to look at the rigged maps, look at the billion-dollar donor class, and decide it's not worth the fight. They want a quiet, predictable election where career politicians like Scott Desjarlais never have to face a real, well-funded counter-attack.

GOD'S CHILDREN ARE NOT FOR SALE

Friend,

A child who has been trafficked often learns a heartbreaking lesson:

Don't trust anyone.
Not adults.
Not authority figures.

Not even the people trying to help.

That is one of the many reasons I am writing to you today.

My name is Eduardo Verástegui. I am the producer of the film Sound of Freedom and founder of the Sound of Freedom Foundation.

After learning firsthand about the horrors of child trafficking, I dedicated my life to helping protect vulnerable children and supporting efforts to stop this evil.

Over the years, I have met brave men and women who dedicate their lives to rescuing children from trafficking and exploitation.

They walk into places most of us could never imagine.

They investigate crimes no human being should ever have to see.

They sit with children whose innocence has been stolen.

And they carry those memories with them.

Day after day.
Year after year.

That burden is heavy.

https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ5MDh9AAwAAAAAAS-Sd4mHWP2bS5_TXIaK6Iw5Oa9YgYxt0T7-zdB78aB4W6k1I65NogAOV4Gqi_tajjhfPWQXC8h47QiwmfWXcB1O6MeQIkmbfrl9izis
Give Now. Bring Comfort.

Sometimes heavier than words can describe.

And that is why I want you to meet someone very special.

Her name is Molly.

https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ5MDh9AAwAAAAAAS-Sd4mIseGd6Uu9uE-Nnjxv_J3_RO2s2cpbuzLgYMSdd60zGStnmP01s7DrOACfa9qXZDyYmRtQ-dEVSpeSXCUeS3irqfQ5MdwWATUE

Molly is a Labradoodle.

But to the officers, investigators, and rescued children she serves, she is so much more than a dog.

She is a source of comfort.
A source of peace.
A source of healing.

When an officer has spent hours working a difficult trafficking case, when they’ve witnessed evil no person should ever have to witness and the weight of the day feels almost unbearable...

Molly quietly walks over.

She leans against them.
And she stays.

She does not ask questions.
She does not need explanations.

Her presence alone reminds them they are not carrying this burden by themselves.

Sometimes that simple moment is enough to help someone breathe again.

https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ5MDh9AAwAAAAAAS-Sd4mJZZ1dL5look8_vPLcS9j5Skmd9uALmS5cY0kOcu_yrFQvdG2J2jxqt-JSUJOM_QAIzRnvlbsB2EFvyi6jkKXpUX9Y--CG4WuC
Give Now. Bring Comfort.

But Molly's work does not stop there.

Some of the children rescued from trafficking are terrified, confused, and broken.

Many have been manipulated for so long that they do not immediately trust the people trying to help them.

Imagine that. Rescue has arrived. But trauma has taught them to fear everyone.

Then Molly enters the room.

No uniform. No questions. No pressure.

Just gentleness and love.

https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ5MDh9AAwAAAAAAS-Sd4mKhOxRb0xj3Jw_8bgFXmOfKZaCaxbH_zSXBPs2dhehUQFHR4SccZVuzAPyMlFe_qPNv99OGkUvdhtWyre2tQv17LvaMwpINA3v

And somehow, walls begin to come down.

Small hands reach out. Tears begin to flow. Fear begins to soften.

And healing can begin.

That healing does not happen by accident.

It happens because one of our trusted anti-trafficking partners walks alongside survivors and the agencies that serve them.

They provide trauma-informed support, resources, and advocacy for lives shattered by trafficking.

Every day, they help children move from fear to freedom, from exploitation to safety, and from hopelessness to renewed hope.

https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ5MDh9AAwAAAAAAS-Sd4mLxD7BMnrYh0EsXCdUT2N-S29vJU84qGt385jZY4mkWnpkmBbLGqmKsaLxQzKKFnOlGYNaN3c8yR_egLHwom2cjI8qC3uGSOm2
Give Now. Bring Comfort.

I have seen firsthand how powerful these moments can be.

They remind me of the words of Jesus:

"Let the little children come to Me and do not hinder them." (Matthew 19:14)

Every child deserves safety, protection and every child deserves to know they are loved.

And sometimes God uses something as simple as a dog named Molly to help a hurting child take the first step toward healing.

What many people do not realize is that dogs like Molly require up to two years of specialized training.

They are carefully prepared to remain calm in chaotic situations.

They comfort children experiencing trauma and support officers carrying enormous emotional burdens.

They serve in places where hope can feel hard to find.

This training, care, and support are only possible because compassionate people choose to stand with this mission.

https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ5MDh9AAwAAAAAAS-Sd4mMGbfvuLSVU1CWA5-58mUet-k1YcOeSHPc9IYfK6HepNvDgZblxJe7LstbZcn8dbz2ByNo5Z8Rtbinjl8ojiht-DLoC9EC3N6H
Give Now. Bring Comfort.

Friend, every rescue operation involves people willing to walk into darkness so others can find freedom.

But even heroes need support.

And so do the children they serve.

And sometimes healing begins with four paws, a gentle heart, and a quiet presence named Molly.

Today, I am asking if you will become part of that healing.

Your first gift of $25, $50, $100, or whatever God places on your heart will bring comfort, hope, and care to vulnerable children and those protecting them.

Because every child matters.

And every act of compassion matters.

Will you make your first gift today?

Together, we can help protect God's children and bring light into some of the darkest places on earth.

With gratitude and prayer,

## Texas Community's Foreclosures Lead the Nation
Texas is averaging [roughly 4,000 foreclosure filings per month](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0LGOhCAYBOCn0Q4DCKIFxTV2e-2VBuV3JfcLG_hX17e_7L7CdVNMvkzm5zbdXMAQ799uB0uvNU0RzoJABHmi1zOGI7v4W1pN2x3T7BCv002Sy47xjgk9eRfwmlTt7cz9IGqwwvRCS9Gqod6sUb0xbuZc85UPZmmHodW9nsF0Urair4N9Y7wTWggupW6MH7TQynGlVj1zVSkOPlDKDW1A8HJlxSsdkJsl7TXajehRqvarkmMlx_M8m2cMBL6QIygZHMInhnhAeTNL2is5fiS2pH1_1y-G4Hxh0VFIkYXI1pRhwVSeGUolxzpb_zgDYiidqRS_7y7gZwH977fDyr8AAAD__6fphFA) through early 2026, with Harris County emerging as one of the top foreclosure hotspots in the country.
